verdict.rationale: Vue's docs describe it as a 'Progressive' framework with an 'incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework', and official Vue Router and Pinia support full applications. Community reports back both ends: dropping in vue.min.js with no bundler, 'sprucing up' old apps here and there, and teams scaffolding full apps with the official router and store. Some opinions that Vue struggles with very complex apps are general skepticism, not concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how to mount Vue into part of an existing page (the evidence is tagline-level only)
